stem: What is the primary definitive surgical treatment for biliary atresia in infants?
explanation: This surgery involves connecting a loop of the small intestine directly to the liver hilum to facilitate bile drainage.
rationale: This procedure is named after a Japanese surgeon and involves a Roux-en-Y intestinal loop.

optionExplanations.A: This surgery involves connecting a loop of the small intestine directly to the liver hilum to facilitate bile drainage.
optionExplanations.B: While many patients eventually need a transplant, the Kasai procedure is the first-line attempt to preserve the native liver.
optionExplanations.C: Removing the gallbladder does not address the underlying progressive destruction and scarring of the extrahepatic bile ducts.
optionExplanations.D: ERCP is a diagnostic and therapeutic tool for certain biliary issues but cannot repair the idiopathic ductal damage found in biliary atresia.
